description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'read-tree' command in a git test environment. It contains setup commands, test cases with expectations, and checks for different scenarios involving git tree operations, untracked files, merge conflicts, symbolic links, and directory/file state changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the given commands, and checks the outcome.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Runs the read-tree command expecting it to succeed; outputs error message on failure.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the read-tree command expecting it to fail; outputs error message on success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Marks a test case that must fail, typically used to confirm erroneous behavior is correctly handled.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after tests are completed.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and adds it to git index for testing symlink behavior.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates passage of time or creates timestamp entries for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual files or outputs in tests.
